import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
tsv=S.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query=xref:panther-PTHR13651'
          '&fields=accession,organism_name,sequence&format=tsv',timeout=180).text
L=[l.split('\t') for l in tsv.strip().split('\n')]; hdr=L[0]
recs=[dict(zip(hdr,r)) for r in L[1:] if 150<len(r[-1])<400]
MOUSE=[r for r in recs if r['Entry']=='Q80ZQ9'][0]['Sequence']
bl="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V

-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -2 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rr=bl.split('\n'); AA=rr[0].split(); SUB=np.full((128,128),-4.0)
for a,row in zip(AA,rr[1:]):
    for b,v in zip(AA,row.split()): SUB[ord(a),ord(b)]=float(v)
mo=np.frombuffer(MOUSE.encode(),dtype=np.uint8); n=len(MOUSE); G=-8.0; NEG=-1e9
def nw_diag(b):
    bo=np.frombuffer(b.encode(),dtype=np.uint8); m=len(b); Sm=SUB[np.ix_(mo,bo)]
    H=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    H[0,:]=G*np.arange(m+1); H[:,0]=G*np.arange(n+1); P[0,1:]=2; P[1:,0]=1
    for d in range(2,n+m+1):
        i=np.arange(max(1,d-m),min(n,d-1)+1)
        if not len(i): continue
        j=d-i
        cand=np.stack([H[i-1,j-1]+Sm[i-1,j-1],H[i-1,j]+G,H[i,j-1]+G])
        k=np.argmax(cand,0); H[i,j]=cand[k,np.arange(len(i))]; P[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; col=np.full(n,'-',dtype='<U1')
    while i>0 and j>0:
        k=P[i,j]
        if k==0: col[i-1]=b[j-1]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif k==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return col
WANT=['Homo sapiens','Danio rerio','Xenopus','Gallus gallus','Drosophila melanogaster',
      'Caenorhabditis elegans','Ciona','Nematostella','Arabidopsis thaliana',
      'Dictyostelium discoideum','Saccharomyces cerevisiae','Schizosaccharomyces pombe',
      'Trypanosoma','Plasmodium','Tetrahymena','Chlamydomonas']
PATCH=[92,96,98,99,128,130,161]; ml=np.array(list(MOUSE))
rows=[{'organism':'Mus musculus','accession':'Q80ZQ9','len':n,'pct_id':100.0,'core_pct_id':100.0,
       **{f"{MOUSE[p-1]}{p}":MOUSE[p-1] for p in PATCH},'n_basic':7}]
for w in WANT:
    cand=[r for r in recs if r['Organism'].startswith(w)]
    if not cand: print(f"  {w}: no PTHR13651 entry"); continue
    r=sorted(cand,key=lambda x:-len(x['Sequence']))[0]
    c=nw_diag(r['Sequence'])
    d={'organism':r['Organism'][:38],'accession':r['Entry'],'len':len(r['Sequence']),
       'pct_id':round(100*(c==ml).mean(),1),'core_pct_id':round(100*(c[22:190]==ml[22:190]).mean(),1)}
    for p in PATCH: d[f"{MOUSE[p-1]}{p}"]=c[p-1]
    d['n_basic']=sum(1 for p in PATCH if c[p-1] in 'KR')
    rows.append(d)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); pd.set_option('display.width',260)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv('/agent/jobs/7fa3ef47-758c-4d83-8be4-ef31af2ced2a/provenance/ortholog_patch_table.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5,4.8))
o=df.sort_values('core_pct_id')
ax.barh(o.organism,o.core_pct_id,color=['#c44e52' if x=='Q80ZQ9' else '#4878a8' for x in o.accession])
for i,(org,v,nb) in enumerate(zip(o.organism,o.core_pct_id,o.n_basic)):
    ax.text(v+1,i,f"{v:.0f}% id   {nb}/7 patch positions Lys or Arg",va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,145); ax.set_xlabel('% identity to mouse over the ordered core, residues 23-190')
ax.set_title('Abitram core identity and retention of the basic patch across eukaryotes')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
